name: sn2_right_eye_lut_redirect
description: SN2 right-eye LUT redirect starting point. Duplicate a base override manifest, set this as right_transform/right_dxil_transform, and fill the SRV range/index values from the flagged right-eye draw's reflection + descriptor lineage.

transforms.note: Most LUT/post-process shaders sample one or more SRVs.
Set from_* to the wrong right-eye SRV and to_* to the matching left/right-correct SRV.
